svg.title: 松原花音 MATSUBARA KANON
svg.desc: Vector name plate. Content: the text element with id="t" holds the CJK name and the element with class="name" holds the latin name; both are centre anchored, so any string works. Colours are CSS custom properties on the root svg: plate, plate-dot, plate-edge, title, title-ring, title-halo, name and star, each prefixed with a double dash. Override them from the embedding page or an inline style.
